# One requirement per line; format: <source-L-doc>: <description>

L10: Reset behavior verification.
L10: Register access (read/write to all fields; reserved-bit behavior).
L10: Nominal transfer / transaction across the protocol's operating modes.
L10: Error and fault condition handling.
L10: Back-to-back / sustained operation.
L16: Two conductors: DQ (data line) + GND (ground reference).
L16: DQ is open-drain wired-AND; HIGH = released (pulled up by Rp).
L16: Master initiates every transaction; slaves never initiate non-presence traffic.
L16: Reset Pulse ≥ 480 µs at standard speed (≥ 48 µs at overdrive).
L16: Slaves respond to Reset with a Presence Pulse 15-60 µs after master release, lasting 60-240 µs.
L16: Time slots are master-initiated; minimum slot duration 60 µs at standard speed.
L16: Bit encoding: Write-1 = master LOW 1-15 µs then HIGH; Write-0 = master LOW for full slot; Read = master LOW 1-15 µs then
L16: All bytes transmitted LSB-first.
L16: Every slave has a unique 64-bit ROM ID: 8-bit family code + 48-bit serial + 8-bit CRC-8.
L16: CRC-8 polynomial: x^8 + x^5 + x^4 + 1 (0x31, reflected 0x8C, initial 0).
L16: ROM command set: Read ROM (0x33), Match ROM (0x55), Skip ROM (0xCC), Search ROM (0xF0).
L16: Inter-slot recovery ≥ 1 µs.
L16: Slaves drop out on first ROM-ID bit mismatch during Match / Search ROM.
L16: Network radius ≤ 750 m (protocol fails beyond this due to cable delay).
